scope: Already reserved verified Astra stage window; source-only operator handoff. Root did not play or operate the browser.
preconditions: Exact full CI, sealed package/tooling and original-store readiness
Owned server/store/origin/watchdog and verified Astra browser lease
Normally onboarded actor, actual city/location, no competing active life action
Working actual 3D scene; fallback status is not driving acceptance

checks.action: Open actual Driving school; use Start practice if no retained lesson/pass exists.
checks.expect: Loading completes; Getting into the car and door/walk/seat animation visible; controls enable after entry. Preserve any existing lesson/pass.

checks.action: Use WASD/arrows for throttle/brake/steering and release them.
checks.expect: Actual motion/server gauges respond, no held input remains after release; elapsed time alone cannot complete checkpoints.

checks.action: At supported320/390 layouts use Analog steering and Hold to accelerate/Hold to brake; release/cancel pointers.
checks.expect: Controls fit, remain reachable and affect movement without stuck input or tap interception.
checks.qualification: Browser viewport/pointer only; actual physical phone/touch/performance remains separate.

checks.action: Drive into braking zone, fully stop, then actively steer along route toward turning.
checks.expect: Actual server-validated movement/full stop advances checkpoint; timer or crossing required-stop zone alone cannot pass.

checks.action: Pause safely on incomplete run, record saved checkpoint/pose, reload normally and reopen school.
checks.expect: Same saved journey/checkpoint, zero-speed paused state, neutral controls and no automatic driving.

checks.action: Use Resume saved lesson explicitly and continue.
checks.expect: Controls recover and previous checkpoint remains; uncertain/offline delivery requires Reconnect and check lesson.

checks.action: Complete turning/parking normally. After Practice passed, claim simulated qualification/free starter permission once, then reload/reopen.
checks.expect: Earned result and qualification/permission persist bound to same journey, with no duplicate reward/charge.
checks.ifFailed: Record failure honestly; no set-result/coordinates/time/funding/save injection; bounded normal retry only.

checks.action: Read actual qualification and permission text.
checks.expect: Simulated qualification is distinct from real licence; free permission does not claim allocated car, mapped driving or delivered stock.

evidenceRequired: Exact source/package/origin and actual operator/model receipt
Owner sanitized same-journey checkpoint, qualification/permission before-after witness
Real wall-clock play; no injected saves/coordinates/results or test-clock advance
programmeStillOpen: Trip checkpoint to parcel custody/restock wages
